verdict.rationale: A game engine could plausibly ship in-editor AI insights or suggestions, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no such feature. The Neural Network Engine (NNE) is a beta developer building block for running neural networks, not a built-in feature that generates insights from the user's data. Unreal Insights is non-AI telemetry and profiling analysis, an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
